notes.subject: ũira
notes.rationale: Gĩkũyũ ĩhoya ĩrehithagĩra kĩng'uria-inĩ kĩa ũira; Kĩhibirania nĩ kĩuga gĩa kũũĩra kĩhumo

notes.subject: רחמיך
notes.rationale: rahamim — nĩ 'mĩmera ya thĩnĩ' na 'mũitho wa kũigua tha'; kiugo kĩmwe kĩa Gĩkũyũ gĩtarĩ kĩonanagia mondo icio yothe

notes.subject: mĩharo
notes.rationale: פשעי nĩ 'mĩharo ya kũhinga ũthamaki' — mũingĩ wa mbaara ya kĩamĩrĩru, ti mahĩtia o kwene

notes.subject: to Erohimu
notes.rationale: Kĩhooto kĩrĩa kĩarĩrĩrĩria Erohimu kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kwa ũthĩ wa Dawidi

translation: Nĩndũhe ⟨ũira⟩, Erohimu, ta hecedi wakwa-inĩ waku; ta ũiyũkĩri wa rahamim waku, ũciorithie ⟨את⟩ mĩharo yakwa.
